symptom: `textbox (Attribute: PlannedOn)` in a data view, or `ContentParams: ({1} = PlannedOn)` / `CaptionParams`, on an entity without that attribute: check --references passed, exec wrote it, mxbuild CE1613 "The selected attribute 'M.E.PlannedOn' no longer exists" — measured 3 of 3 on a fresh 11.12.6 app, control page clean
cause: the input-widget scope walk (checkInputBinding) looked the attribute up and returned silently when it was not found unless the name was an association; template parameters were never looked up
insight: The context walk, the member index with inheritance and the association hops were already there for the type rule (MDL-WIDGET39) — the not-found case was a silent `return` in it. Before writing a new resolver, grep for the lookup that already returns found/known and see what it does on a miss. Stay quiet where the index is not sure: an unknown chain (known=false), an unresolved context, an altered entity, an expression or $var path, and the audit members (createdDate/changedDate/owner/changedBy), which bind by name but are not in the attribute list. Control: without the two calls the textbox and content-parameter subtests pass check.
